commit.message:
Point the container pin at a tag that exists; bump to 5.0.5

The release workflow strips the v prefix, so GHCR holds secat:5.0.4 and
:latest while nextflow.config pinned secat:v5.0.3 - a tag that has never
existed. Pins now use the published form.
